title: NTP: Throw exception on private (mode 7) items with no length
description:
If a NTP reserved for private use (mode 7) message has nonzero
items each with zero length, that's malformed.

This is not a security or DOS issue because the number of items
is limited to 12 bits.

Cleanup the code a bit.

Fix #21273

AI-Assisted: no
